evidence.title: Xquik: X (Twitter) Scraper API, MCP & Automation Tools

name: Xquik
summary: X (Twitter) scraper and automation API: search, extract and export posts, monitor accounts, publish, MCP server.
description: An independent X (Twitter) data platform with 53 dashboard tools: search and extract tweets, replies, profiles, followers, lists, communities and Spaces; AI analysis such as sentiment, brand mentions and viral score; publishing from connected accounts; and trending sources including Reddit, GitHub, Hacker News, Google and Wikipedia. Integrates through a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 contract, a remote MCP endpoint, signed webhooks, TypeScript/Python/Go/Ruby SDKs and a CLI; exports to CSV, XLSX, JSON or Markdown. Not affiliated with X Corp.
contains: 53 dashboard tools: extraction, AI analysis, write actions, trending
REST API with OpenAPI 3.1 contract and a remote MCP endpoint
SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go and Ruby, plus a CLI
exports CSV, XLSX, JSON and Markdown
monitors accounts and keywords with 1-second checks and signed webhook events
pay-as-you-go from $10 or monthly plans at $20, $99 and $199
